entries.title: AI Daily Digest - 2026-09-23
entries.summary: Two days after frontier labs called for pacing AI, Anthropic and OpenAI each shipped cheaper models Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol/Luna signaling that price pressure still outranks voluntary slowdowns. China's open-weight stack accelerated the same day: Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6-Pro tied Grok 4.7 on the intelligence index, and Alibaba unveiled its Zhenwu V900 accelerator with a 20GW data-center roadmap. Governance moved multilateral as DeepSeek prepared to brief the UN Security Council, while Palo Alto Networks operationalized frontier models for continuous cyber defense.

news.title: Anthropic and OpenAI Ship Cheaper Frontier Models
news.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol/Luna launch as first releases since the slowdown call.

news.title: Xiaomi Releases MiMo-V2.6 Open Weights at Frontier-Class Performance
news.summary: MiMo-V2.6-Pro scores 46 on AAII v4.3, tying Grok 4.7.

news.title: Alibaba Unveils Zhenwu V900 Chip and 20GW Data Center Roadmap
news.summary: T-Head V900 triples predecessor performance; 20GW cloud capacity by 2032.

news.title: DeepSeek to Brief UN Security Council on AI This Week
news.summary: Chinese lab joins OpenAI and Anthropic at UN AI security briefing.

news.title: Palo Alto Networks Launches AI-Native Continuous Cyber Defense
news.summary: Unit 42 service uses Claude Mythos 5 and GPT-5.6-Cyber for continuous scanning.
